documentation.text:
Placeholder capped token for the WP0 smoke check (`make check`).
 WP1 owns the real contract; this version is only minimal and correct.
 `owner` and `cap` are storage variables, not immutables, so the runtime
 bytecode does not depend on constructor arguments.

WP0 smoke harness (b), in the spec format of specs/SPEC_FORMAT.md:
 a tautological assert on a reachable path. Expected Check verdict: Accept.
 The path is the same as in ReachableFalse.sol, whose counterexample shows
 that it is reachable, so this proof is not vacuous.
